title: Practice 02 — 낡은 집으로 들어서는 Sarah의 긴장
fullPassage: Sarah approached the old, falling-apart house. Her heart was pounding in her chest as she imagined all the horrors that could be hiding in its dark hallways. Sarah took a deep breath, paused for a moment, then gathered her courage to push open the squeaky door and enter the mysterious house. As she stepped inside and felt the warmth of sunlight filtering through the dusty windows, a sense of wonder and interest washed over her. The squeaky floors under her feet didn't seem to whisper tales of ghosts; instead, they sang a song of history and forgotten memories. With each step, Sarah's initial fear melted away, revealing an unstoppable desire to uncover the secrets hidden within the walls of this old house.
